meta.note: Fully fictional demo data. Names, employers, schools, links and numbers are invented for tests and documentation. Contains no real personal information.

text.en: Rebuilt the order ingestion pipeline, cutting p99 latency from 1.8s to 240ms at 40k events/min.
text.zh: 重构订单接入管道，将 p99 延迟从 1.8 秒降至 240 毫秒，峰值 4 万事件/分钟。

text.en: Led a four-engineer team through a zero-downtime migration of the billing datastore.
text.zh: 带领四人团队完成计费数据存储的零停机迁移。

text.en: Owned the search relevance service; improved top-3 precision by 11 points against the shipped baseline.
text.zh: 负责搜索相关性服务，将前三条结果的准确率相对上线基线提升 11 个百分点。

text.en: Mentored two junior engineers through their first production launch.
text.zh: 指导两名初级工程师完成他们的首次生产上线。

text.en: Open-source audit-log store with deterministic replay; 1.2k stars and 40 contributing authors.
text.zh: 开源审计日志存储，支持确定性重放；1.2k star，40 位贡献者。

text.en: Designed the append-only segment format that keeps writes O(1) regardless of retention window.
text.zh: 设计仅追加的分段格式，使写入复杂度与保留窗口无关，恒为 O(1)。

text.en: Side project that renders reproducible charts from a declarative spec; used in two internal talks.
text.zh: 业余项目，从声明式规范生成可复现图表；已在两次内部演讲中使用。

summary.en: B.Sc. Computer Science. Coursework in distributed systems and information retrieval.
summary.zh: 计算机科学理学学士，主修分布式系统与信息检索。

name.en: Lightweight Retrieval Calibration for Small Language Models
name.zh: 面向小型语言模型的轻量检索校准方法

summary.en: A workshop paper on calibrating retrieval depth without retraining the underlying model.
summary.zh: 一篇工作区论文，讨论在不重训底层模型的情况下校准检索深度。
